podcast.body: This album was a direct result of Matthew Good's experiences with his bipolar disorder, his manic episode, and subsequent hospitalization. The creation of the record was a deeply cathartic experience for him, marking a significant personal and creative period in his life. "The result of Matt's experience was an album entitled Hospital Music."
